title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

title: No Smoking
desc: A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.

title: Karobaar : The Business Of Love
desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.

title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.
